title: Check and revise a fictional AI event notice

outcomes.description: Given a source and AI draft, distinguish supported, contradictory, and unknown claims.
Revise the draft for its audience and explain a correction using source evidence.

practice.description: Compare a worked correction, then repair another claim with a source hint.
Revise a short notice, compare with a peer, and retry with feedback.

assessments.description: Independently revise a new fictional notice and explain one evidence-based change.

rubric.description: Stated facts are supported; unknowns remain omitted or flagged.
The revision meets audience and task constraints.
The rationale links an edit to a specific source discrepancy.
